plugins.name: polyspace-core
plugins.description: Cross-product foundations for the Polyspace Agentic Toolkit — resolve the Polyspace installation root, configure build options, and find Polyspace documentation entry points. Every toolkit user needs these.

plugins.name: polyspace-static-core
plugins.description: Shared static-analysis skills for Polyspace as You Code, Bug Finder, and Code Prover — review, fix, and justify findings (in code or in the results database), configure checkers, and find checker/option documentation. Install alongside any Polyspace static-analysis product.

plugins.name: polyspace-as-you-code
plugins.description: Run Polyspace as You Code file-level static analysis on the C/C++ file you are editing to find defects and coding-standard violations. Pairs with polyspace-static-core for reviewing, fixing, and justifying findings.

plugins.name: polyspace-bug-finder
plugins.description: Run Polyspace Bug Finder across several C/C++ files or a whole component to find defects and coding-standard violations. Pairs with polyspace-static-core for reviewing, fixing, and justifying findings.

plugins.name: polyspace-code-prover
plugins.description: Run and review Polyspace Code Prover to prove the absence of run-time errors in C/C++ code, and triage orange (unproven) checks. Pairs with polyspace-static-core for justifying findings.

plugins.name: polyspace-test
plugins.description: Generate, build, run, and measure coverage of C/C++ unit tests with the Polyspace XUnit framework (PSTUnit)
